name: seatledger
description: seatledger, the local ledger of what your coding-agent seats and tokens buy, from inside Claude Code: tokens and API-equivalent dollars by day, project, model and client, and step changes in how requests use tokens. Open source, no account, nothing sent anywhere.

plugins.name: seatledger
plugins.description: Read what this machine's Claude Code and Codex usage bought. /seatledger:usage runs `npx seatledger` and explains today, the last 7 days and your limits; /seatledger:rates runs `npx seatledger rates` and explains any step change in tokens per request, cache use or quota per token.
